elements.requirement: The Agricultural Wages Act 1948, the Agricultural Wages (Scotland) Act 1949, and the Agricultural Wages (Regulation) (Northern Ireland) Order 1977 must be amended in accordance with Schedule 2 to the National Minimum Wage Act 1998.
elements.quote: shall be amended in accordance with Schedule 2 to this Act

elements.requirement: The appropriate authority may by regulations amend the Agricultural Wages Act 1948, the Agricultural Wages (Scotland) Act 1949, section 67 of the Agriculture Act 1967 (sick pay), section 46 of the Agriculture (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1968 (further functions of agricultural wages committees), and the Agricultural Wages (Regulation) (Northern Ireland) Order 1977.
elements.quote: The appropriate authority may by regulations amend— (a) the Agricultural Wages Act 1948; (b) the Agricultural Wages (Scotland) Act 1949; (c) section 67 of the Agriculture Act 1967 (sick pay); (d) section 46 of the Agriculture (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1968 (further functions of agricultural wages committees); and (e) the Agricultural Wages (Regulation) (Northern Ireland) Order 1977.

elements.requirement: The amendments that the appropriate authority may make under section 47(2) of the National Minimum Wage Act 1998 are limited to any amendments which are consequential on that Act or on regulations under section 1(4), 2, or 3 of that Act.
elements.quote: The amendments that may be made under subsection (2) above are any amendments which are consequential on this Act or on regulations under section 1(4), 2 or 3 above.

elements.requirement: The appropriate authority may by regulations amend, or make provision in substitution for, section 7 of the Agricultural Wages Act 1948 (reckoning of benefits and advantages as payment of wages), section 7 of the Agricultural Wages (Scotland) Act 1949 (similar provision for Scotland), or Article 4(3) and (5) of the Agricultural Wages (Regulation) (Northern Ireland) Order 1977.
elements.quote: The appropriate authority may by regulations amend, or make provision in substitution for,— (a) section 7 of the Agricultural Wages Act 1948 (reckoning of benefits and advantages as payment of wages); (b) section 7 of the Agricultural Wages (Scotland) Act 1949 (similar provision for Scotland); or (c) Article 4(3) and (5) of the Agricultural Wages (Regulation) (Northern Ireland) Order 1977.

elements.requirement: Subsection (1) of section 47 of the National Minimum Wage Act 1998 takes effect without prejudice to subsections (2) to (4) of section 47 of that Act.
elements.quote: Subsection (1) above is without prejudice to subsections (2) to (4) above.
